## Objective

Delete retired workflow surfaces while preserving current setup, routing, export, install, and retro capabilities.

## Owned scope

Delete retired decisions D18, D31, D32, D37, and D52; retire D46 historical citations while preserving its live adapter warning behavior. Remove handoff, SessionStart, Cautilus, and obsolete closeout routing, fixtures, tests, and prose. Compact `docs/public-skill-dogfood.json` from append-only history to current acceptance evidence while preserving its 19 live cases. Remove duplicated dogfood Markdown lists and obsolete catalog/adoption entries with their producers.

## Acceptance

- Retired workflow and decision surfaces are absent from current routing and validation.
- Each dogfood case retains current acceptance evidence.
- Current AGENTS/setup generation, retro-owned session audit, export/sync, and install checks remain functional.
- No deletion is replaced by a catalog exclusion or compatibility wrapper.
